author: Inside Edition
description: Lunch ladies are often overlooked or ignored as they serve meals to millions of students across the United States. At John Marshall High School in Cleveland, they feed 1,500 students twice a day. If anyone deserves a day of pampering, it's them. Inside Edition took them to a top Cleveland salon, Marco Alexzander. Hair stylists gave each lunch lady the royal treatment.
title: Lunch Ladies Get Treated To Makeovers

author: Inside Edition
description: The family of JonBenet Ramsey are denouncing an upcoming Netflix documentary about her unsolved killing. It stars Melissa McCarthy as JonBenet's late mother Patsy Ramsey. British actor Clive Owen plays JonBenet's father John Ramsey. The Ramsey family is condemning the series, saying they are deeply concerned.
title: JonBenet Ramsey's Family Denounces Netflix Series About Her Killing

author: Inside Edition
description: Greenland and Antarctica are cold, remote places that most of us will never visit, but they are important to Earth and the environment. Now scientists are issuing a dire warning that these places are melting away. A new report from Northumbria University in the UK says these polar places have lost nearly 12 trillion tons of ice since the 1970s, raising sea levels by three centimeters. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Scientists Warn Of Ocean Impact After Glaciers Lost Trillions Of Tons Of Ice

author: Inside Edition
description: Inside Edition investigates the disturbing trend of staged animal rescue videos flooding social media. A new documentary, "Cruelty for Clicks," exposes scam artists who deliberately place animals in danger — then "rescue" them on camera for views and profit. Animal cruelty expert Nina Jackel says those videos have racked up billions of views and millions in revenue for scammers. She shares with us the telltale signs that give away the scam.
title: Staged Animal Rescue Videos Rake In Millions For Scammers

author: Inside Edition
description: It was a daring rescue to save a lost soul. Firefighters in Italy say a shepherd dog got away from its owner and was found in a dangerous location: the ledge of a mountain more than 8,000 feet high.  A helicopter and a brave rescuer responded to the call in the Italian Alps. Hanging by a rope, the firefighter used a net to scoop up the dog and then they were both lifted aboard the aircraft. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Firefighters Save Dog From High Ledge In Italy's Alps
